title: Helicopter Crashes While Fighting Utah Wildfire, Crew Fate Unknown
summary: A Sikorsky S-64 Skycrane helicopter crashed in central Utah while battling the Widemouth 2 wildfire. The crash occurred near Richfield, and the pilot and a crewmember were fatally injured. The wildfire, one of the largest in the region, prevented immediate rescue efforts. The downed helicopter was one of seven working the blaze, which also ignited another fire.
summary_points: A Sikorsky S-64 Skycrane helicopter crashed in central Utah.
The helicopter was engaged in fighting the Widemouth 2 wildfire.
The pilot and a crewmember sustained fatal injuries.
A wildfire blocked access to the crash site, delaying rescue.
The crashed helicopter was one of seven deployed on the fire.
